key_terms.يَطْمِثْهُنَّ: To consummate marriage or have sexual relations with

ai.seo_question: Who are the undefiled wives of Paradise mentioned in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the unique spiritual and physical purity of the believers' spouses in Jannah, distinguishing them from the wives of this world who may have had prior relations. The phrase 'no human or jinn' emphasizes their exclusive consecration to their righteous husbands, reflecting the divine justice that rewards the faithful with undivided companionship. This concept is often linked to the idea of 'Hoor al-Ayn' as a specific reward for the pious, highlighting both physical virginity and spiritual exclusivity.
